title: A small family of stratum-product and subobject models for integral constructible sheaves
statement: Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$ as in [def-weil-size-convention], with schemes and scalar coefficient rings in $\mathcal U$, small site skeletons and module sections in $\mathcal V$. Let $X$ be a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $\ell$ be a prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and put $R_T=p_T^*\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ for every scheme $T$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Modules mean sheaves of $R_T$-modules on the fixed small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. A finite constant local model on $T$ means a module pro-étale locally isomorphic to $R_U\otimes_{\underline{\mathcal O_E}}\underline P$, with $P$ a finitely presented scalar $\mathcal O_E$-module [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. There is a $\mathcal V$-small set of representative such sheaves $\{F_{T,t}\}_{t\in I_T}$ for every stratum $T$ of every finite locally closed scheme stratification of $X$ [def-constructible-stratification]. Let $J$ index all pairs consisting of a finite stratification $(a_s:S_s\hookrightarrow X)_{s<n}$ within the fixed scheme bound and a tuple $(t_s\in I_{S_s})_{s<n}$. Then $J$ is a $\mathcal V$-small set. For $j$ given by this pair put $P_j=\prod_{s<n}a_{s*}F_{S_s,t_s}$, using the module adjunctions $a_s^*\dashv a_{s*}$ of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. For every constructible $R_X$-module $C$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible] there are $j\in J$ and isomorphisms $\varphi_s:a_s^*C\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{S_s,t_s}$ such that the map $u:C\to P_j$ with components $a_{s*}(\varphi_s)\circ\eta_{s,C}$ is a monomorphism, where $\eta_s$ is the adjunction unit. For each $j$, subobjects of $P_j$, up to isomorphism over $P_j$, are represented by a $\mathcal V$-small set of image subsheaves; each image is specified by a family of subsets of $P_j(V)$ indexed by objects $V$ of the small site. Thus the family of all these image subsheaves, for all $j\in J$, is $\mathcal V$-small. The empty stratification is allowed when $X$ is empty, with product the zero module sheaf.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-proetale-scalar-local-model-representatives] to every bounded stratum $T$. It gives precisely the required finite constant local model representatives $(F_{T,t})_{t\in I_T}$. The strata form a $\mathcal V$-small set by [def-weil-size-convention], so choose these families simultaneously by set-indexed choice in an ambient universe containing $\mathcal V$.

For constructible C, local Noetherianity gives quasi-separatedness, so unfold [sk-def-sfb-constructible] to obtain a finite stratification. Forget its constructibility fields, and choose the labels and restriction isomorphisms from step 1. The source library finite quasi-compact abelian-sheaf detection theorem proves joint zero detection for these immersions: their domains are Noetherian and their maps quasi-compact. Pullback is exact via the recorded coefficient comparison. Apply [lem-sfb-joint-adjunction-model-embedding] directly to obtain the monic canonical product lift. Its projection equations are Pi.lift_π and give precisely the specified adjunction-unit components.

Use [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] to view each product sectionwise. For a monomorphism m, finite-limit preservation of the module-sheaf forgetful functor and Mathlib injective_of_mono give injective section maps. Their linear ranges are stable under restriction by naturality. LinearEquiv.ofInjective gives a natural isomorphism from the source to the range presheaf, transporting its sheaf condition. Fully faithful forgetful transport gives an isomorphism of module sheaves whose composite with inclusion is m. Inclusion is monic by the presheaf submodule inclusion instance. These actual submodule families and the dependent sum over the product indices already lie in the displayed universe.

For empty X construct the finite locally closed stratification with n = 0 explicitly: every field except the covering equation is defined by Fin.elim0, and the covering equation follows because X has no points. Its label tuple is empty. For any index with zero strata, product extensionality identifies its identity with zero, since it has no projections. IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero proves that this empty product is zero. No assertion about arbitrary sheaves on an empty site is needed.
